name: ConsentField
summary: One consent: a Checkbox or Switch whose label is one purpose, a link to the details, an optional record line, and a record of the choice handed to the app. Never ticked in advance.
useWhen: Asking for consent to one use of personal data, such as marketing email or sharing with a partner
A settings list where each use of data can be turned on or off at any time
A consent the service truly cannot work without, such as sharing health data with the clinic being booked
avoidWhen: Accepting terms of service or a contract, which is not consent to a use of data
A preference with no personal data in it, such as dark mode
Asking for several purposes with one control

purpose.description: One sentence that names one purpose. It is the control's label. Required.

checked.description: Controlled: a choice already on record. Needs onCheckedChange, so it can always be withdrawn. There is no defaultChecked.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with true when given, false when withdrawn.

onDecision.description: Called with a record: name, granted, version and the time as ISO 8601, for the app to store.

control.description: checkbox in a form that is sent, switch in settings that save at once.

name.description: The form name. Inside a Form, the Form's error for this name shows here.

detailsHref.description: Where the details live: who gets the data, for how long, how to withdraw. Renders the details link.

detailsLabel.description: The details link text. Arabic default under lang ar.

detailsExternal.description: Opens the details in a new tab.

meta.description: A record line: the version of the text, or when the choice was made.

version.description: The version of the purpose text, passed back in the record.

required.description: The service cannot work without it. Shows an aria-hidden mark and sets aria-required.

invalid.description: When not passed, invalid while an error shows. false hides the error.

error.description: An error shown now, for a required consent left off.

requiredError.description: Inside a Form: the error when the Form finds this required consent left off. Default the Form's required message.

a11y.role: checkbox or switch, from the control. The root has no role.
a11y.focus: The control is the one tab stop of the consent; the details link is the next.

keys.Tab: Moves to the control, then to the details link

a11y.announce: The purpose is the control's name (a native label and aria-labelledby). The record line and the error are read through aria-describedby. Nothing is live.
notes: Design note, not legal advice: the component follows the consent rules of the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and its Implementing Regulations from SDAIA as a design aid only. Consent is explicit (an action by the person), specific (one purpose per control), never given in advance, and as easy to withdraw as to give. The purpose copy, the details page and whether consent is the right legal basis must be checked by someone qualified in PDPL for each product.
Never ticked in advance: there is no defaultChecked prop and the uncontrolled state starts denied. A test proves it.
Withdrawing is the same control and the same one action as giving. In settings, use control switch, so the change saves at once.
Keep the record: store what onDecision returns (granted, the text version, the time) with the account. In a form that is sent, store the last record when the form is sent.
The details link sits outside the label, so a click on it never toggles the consent.
Do not mark a marketing consent required. Required is for a consent the service truly cannot work without.
checked and unchecked are on the control part, a Checkbox or Switch root that carries the consent field control part. The consent root says granted or denied.

en.purpose: A first person sentence that names one use and who gets the data: Share my order history with the delivery partner to plan delivery times. Never a bundle joined with and.
en.details: Names the page: How we use your data. Never Learn more.
en.meta: The version or the date of the choice: You agreed on 3 November 2026. Text version 2.1.
en.error: Why it is needed and the other way: The booking needs this consent. Tick the box, or book by phone instead.

ar.purpose: جملة بصيغة المتكلم تبدأ بأوافق وتذكر استخدام واحد ومين يستلم البيانات: أوافق على مشاركة سجل طلباتي مع شريك التوصيل
ar.error: يوضح ليش مطلوبة والبديل: الحجز يحتاج موافقتك على المشاركة. حدد المربع أو احجز بالاتصال

react.behavior: hand built on Checkbox and Switch, FieldError as the error part, reads the Form error by name

angular.behavior: div[dsConsentField] host bindings, ControlValueAccessor with a boolean value; the error is p[dsFieldError] with its own DsFieldContext through viewProviders; reads the dsForm error for its name through DsFormContext
angular.note: No default checked: there is no defaultChecked input, a static checked does not type check and the state starts denied. onCheckedChange is the checkedChange output of [(checked)], onDecision is the decision output. The Checkbox and Switch are private stand ins with the React DOM until the A3 port merges. ConsentField.css is used as is.

styles.studio: The control at the start, the purpose in text s on the control's center line, a muted record line and a small details link under it
styles.desk: The same layout, in Instrument Sans
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: One checkbox: I agree to the terms, the privacy policy and to receive offers by email
mistakes.right: Terms accepted by the submit button's copy, and one ConsentField per purpose: Send me offers by email.

mistakes.wrong: A consent ticked in advance, so the person has to untick it
mistakes.right: A ConsentField, which always starts denied and has no defaultChecked

mistakes.wrong: Withdrawal only by email to support, or hidden three screens deep
mistakes.right: The same ConsentField with control switch in Settings, one action to withdraw

mistakes.wrong: A Learn more link inside the label, so a click on it ticks the box
mistakes.right: detailsHref, which renders the Link outside the label with a name that says where it goes

mistakes.wrong: A marketing consent marked required to finish sign up
mistakes.right: Marketing consent optional; required only when the service cannot work without it
